Licensed product information in the UK and USA states that no dosage adjustment of letrozole is required for patients with mild to moderate hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh category A and B). While letrozole is contra-indicated in the UK in severe hepatic impairment (Child- Pugh category C), in the USA, it is recommended that the dose of letrozole be reduced by 50% in those patients with cirrhosis and severe hepatic impairment; the recommended dose for these patients is 2.5 mg given every other day.
